predictions.mechanism: Pinned native CUDA-13 SGLang already loads; performance should remain near the published same-model H100 anchor, with placement and harness validity as the main risks.
Supported batching, prefix caching, and EAGLE can reduce repeated prefix work and decode iterations, but MTP acceptance and queueing tails may limit the realized SLO gain.
W4A16 lowers weight traffic and enables a cheaper 48 GB allocation, but Marlin/post-load compatibility, dequantized MLA materialization, and quantization quality are material risks.

falsifiers: A valid H100 control differs from the 660 output-token/s point prediction by more than 35% without an identified workload or hardware cause.
Supported tuning fails to improve SLO goodput by at least 5% at every matched point.
AWQ has another deterministic semantic loader/post-load defect or fails deterministic correctness.
AWQ is compatible but its best SLO-compliant GPU dollars per token are not lower than stock BF16 H100.
The measured candidate ordering differs from the predicted economic ordering.
claim_boundary: These are prospective predictions, not measurements. The AWQ representation/device move is not a custom-stack gain.
